name: Spinach and Tomato Frittata
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Soften the onion, spinach, and tomato in the olive oil in an oven-safe pan.
Pour the whisked eggs over the vegetables and scatter the parmesan on top.
Cook on low until the edges set, then bake at 190C until the centre is fully set and no longer runny.
Cool briefly, slice into wedges, and serve.
